title: Amount Still to Be Paid on an Order Line Settled with Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Credit
content:
When the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry applies registry credit to her or his own order line (a purchase record still in ordered status), the credit is spent on the amount of the line still to be paid. The amount of an order line still to be paid depends on what the line already carries:

- a line with a completion purchase entry on the registry is still to be paid at its selling price less that completion discount;
- a line without one that carries Finch Notes is still to be paid at its selling price less the Finch Notes;
- any other line is still to be paid at its selling price.

The completion purchase entry is the registry's entry for that same purchase record; the Finch Notes are those applied on the purchase record itself.

## Cases (hypothetical lines)

| Selling price | Completion purchase entry for the line | Finch Notes on the line | Amount still to be paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 300.00 | USD 45.00 | none | USD 255.00 |
| USD 300.00 | USD 45.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 255.00 |
| USD 300.00 | none | USD 10.00 | USD 290.00 |
| USD 300.00 | none | none | USD 300.00 |

## Point of judgement

A line that carries both a completion purchase entry and Finch Notes is still to be paid at its selling price less the completion discount; the Finch Notes are taken off only for a line without a completion purchase entry.
